description: Header file defining the AndroidVideoSurfaceChooser class, which manages surface selection for video playback on Android, including state management and client callbacks.

classes.name: AndroidVideoSurfaceChooser
classes.description: Abstract class for choosing video surface type on Android, with state management and client callback setup.

classes.name: State
classes.description: Struct representing the input state used for surface selection, including flags for overlay requirements, fullscreen, security, and other video properties.

methods.name: SetClientCallbacks
methods.description: Sets the callback functions to be invoked when a new surface is chosen.

methods.name: UpdateState
methods.description: Updates the current state and triggers a new surface selection based on the provided state and optional factory.
